title: John Harbaugh on trade deadline approach: If you put it on a scale, now outweighs the future

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: John Harbaugh on trade deadline approach: If you put it on a scale, now outweighs the future
sources.description: There have been a number of big moves on the trade front over the last couple of weeks as teams with eyes on competing for the Super Bowl have made big swings to improve their chances.
